page.overview:
Who is Bardi's brother?

A Brother of the human rebel Bardi. Both were members of the Maya Pei Brigade during the Imperial Era. In 4 BBY, the brigade was attacked and Bardi and his brother were apart of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that escaped aboard a starship that landed on Yavin 4. However Bardi's brother subsequently departed in the ship leaving the rest of the group stranded on the moon. Bardi later claimed that his brother had left look for more survivors however Gerdis doubted the claim, stated that no one believes that.

Bardi's brother was mentioned in the second season of the live-action series Star Wars: Andor, appearing in the series's first episode, "One Year Later" which was released on Disney+
